item.title: How to Choose the Right Input Mode for an AI Video Pipeline
item.summary: AI video projects often lose time before generation begins. A team has a script, several approved images, and a loose collection of brand references, yet every request is sent through the same text prompt because the pipeline treats all inputs alike.
